Then there's another type that's not a visual thinker at all, and they're the ones that memorize all of the sports statistics, all of the weather statistics.
author: Temple Grandin

quote: I think the drummer should sit back there and play some drums, and never mind about the tunes. Just get up there and wail behind whoever is sitting up there playing the solo. And this is what is lacking, definitely lacking in music today.
author: Buddy Rich

quote: Rock and Roll: Music for the neck downwards.
author: Keith Richards

quote: The scarcity of the music not only makes the music itself enjoyable but it also gives the collector a strange sense of superiority.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: Music is about listening, the more you play, the more the magic spreads.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: I learnt a whole lot from my mother. About music, relationships, being a good person, loving people, the whole of life. I learnt about everything from her. Every single day I think about her. All through the day.
author: R. Kelly

quote: Music is for people. The word 'pop' is simply short for popular. It means that people like it. I'm just a normal jerk who happens to make music. As long as my brain and fingers work, I'm cool.
author: Eddie Van Halen

quote: On the other hand, what I like my music to do to me is awaken the ghosts inside of me. Not the demons, you understand, but the ghosts.
author: David Bowie

quote: Music is a fantastic peacekeeper of the world, it is integral to harmony, and it is a required fundamental of human emotion.
author: Xun Zi

quote: Those who have virtue always in their mouths, and neglect it in practice, are like a harp, which emits a sound pleasing to others, while itself is insensible of the music.
author: Diogenes

quote: I just hope that our fans are people who are inspired by music, and just use our music as a background or inspiration for whatever it is they do.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: There is nothing stable in the world uproar's your only music.
author: John Keats

quote: When music fails to agree to the ear, to soothe the ear and the heart and the senses, then it has missed the point.
author: Maria Callas

quote: Through literacy you can begin to see the universe. Through music you can reach anybody. Between the two there is you, unstoppable.
author: Grace Slick

quote: But I feel music has a very important role in ritual activity, and that being able to join in musical activity, along with dancing, could have been necessary at a very early stage of human culture.
author: E. O. Wilson

quote: The world's a better place since I chose music.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: Music is the doorway that has led me to drawing, photography, and writing.
author: Layne Staley

quote: A jazz musician can improvise based on his knowledge of music. He understands how things go together. For a chef, once you have that basis, that's when cuisine is truly exciting.
author: Charlie Trotter

quote: Lean your body forward slightly to support the guitar against your chest, for the poetry of the music should resound in your heart.
author: Andres Segovia

quote: When I was a teenager, I began to settle into school because I'd discovered the extracurricular activities that interested me: music and theater.
author: Morgan Freeman

quote: There's people making babies to my music. That's nice.
author: Barry White

quote: If you want to be a rock star or just be famous, then run down the street naked, you'll make the news or something. But if you want music to be your livelihood, then play, play, play and play! And eventually you'll get to where you want to be.
author: Eddie Van Halen

quote: I came into music just because I wanted the bread. It's true. I looked around and this seemed like the only way I was going to get the kind of bread I wanted.
author: Mick Jagger

quote: You just pick up a chord, go twang, and you're got music.
author: Sid Vicious

quote: Music is the universal language of mankind.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: Nothing pleases me more than to go into a room and come out with a piece of music.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: Music is essentially useless, as is life.
author: George Santayana

quote: Music is a means of giving form to our inner feelings, without attaching them to events or objects in the world.
author: George Santayana

quote: Nothing is capable of being well set to music that is not nonsense.
author: Joseph Addison

quote: I think everybody can agree that you can hear a certain song and it will put you in a certain mood, and that's just the beauty of music and I am so inspired by that.
author: Shaun White

quote: The more a race is governed by its passions, the less it has acquired the habit of cautious and reasoned argument, the more intense will be its love of music.
author: Stendhal

quote: Music is mediator between spiritual and sensual life.
author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quote: I get bored easily, so I need to do a lot. I've started a record label, so I get to nurture new talent and talk about music, which is a passion of mine. I've written another book. And I get to come to work and do the TV show, which is always really fun.
author: Ellen DeGeneres

quote: I'm a big collector of vinyl - I have a record room in my house - and I've always had a huge soundtrack album collection. So what I do, as I'm writing a movie, is go through all those songs, trying to find good songs for fights, or good pieces of music to layer into the film.
author: Quentin Tarantino

quote: No matter how many times people say it - 'Oh, I'm just writing this for myself' 'Oh, I'm just doing this for myself' - nobody's doing it for themselves! You're doing it for an audience. So whether I'm performing or writing a book or playing music, it's definitely to be put out there and to be received in some way, definitely.
author: Steve Martin

quote: I feel good about being able to take bluegrass on to television like 'Letterman' and 'The View,' and I've heard nice things about being able to do that. I really haven't felt any negativity toward me or my music.
author: Steve Martin

quote: I like all kinds of music. I listen to Abigail Washburn, the Punch Brothers, and Marc Johnson, the great clawhammer player. I also listen a lot to Sirius Radio, there's a lot of bluegrass there.
author: Steve Martin

quote: I'm enamored with the art world. Anytime you look at anything that's considered artistic, there's a commercial world around it: the ballet, opera, any kind of music. It can't exist without it.
author: Steve Martin

quote: Music, Rock and Roll music especially, is such a generational thing. Each generation must have their own music, I had my own in my generation, you have yours, everyone I know has their own generation.
author: Ronnie James Dio

quote: Good music comes out of people playing together, knowing what they want to do and going for it. You have to sweat over it and bug it to death. You can't do it by pushing buttons and watching a TV screen.
author: Keith Richards

quote: I had to resign myself, many years ago, that I'm not too articulate when it comes to explaining how I feel about things. But my music does it for me, it really does.
author: David Bowie

quote: I don't want to limit myself musically. It would be really limiting if we'd neglect something we really want to do, like explore other styles of music.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: Why do musicians give so much time to charitable causes? The most humanitarian cause that we can give our time to is the creation and performance of music itself.
author: Billy Joel

quote: I can't satisfy myself with just trying to tie all of my imagination into music, especially when music is not appreciated as an art form as much as it used to be.
author: Marilyn Manson

quote: Art gives me the freedom I don't have when I make music.
author: Marilyn Manson

quote: I decided to make music again at a time when I couldn't have had more obstacles.
author: Marilyn Manson

quote: What I know is my music gets blamed for school shootings.
author: Marilyn Manson

quote: I hope that what you take away from my album is not just the music - which I did want to be fun, and I did want it to be about individuality, but please also take away from it that there's no dream that's too big.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Metal is still the biggest music now in America.
author: Sebastian Bach

quote: The only things Mick and I disagree about is the band, the music and what we do.
author: Keith Richards

quote: I felt I really wanted to back off from music completely and just work within the visual arts in some way. I started painting quite passionately at that time.
author: David Bowie

quote: There's a continuity between what I care about in any form: I care about it in my music, in article-writing, in how I dress, in how I live, in my relationships, in how I navigate paparazzi, how I decorate my home. There's such a continuity between everything that I don't really care what form it shows up in.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Music, when soft voices die Vibrates in the memory.
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quote: My loathings are simple: stupidity, oppression, crime, cruelty, soft music.
author: Vladimir Nabokov

quote: You can't give up something you really believe in for financial reasons. If you die by the roadside - so be it. But at least you know you've tried. Ten minutes in the music scene was the equal of one hundred years outside of it.
author: Robert Plant

quote: Hip-Hop isn't just music, it is also a spiritual movement of the blacks! You can't just call Hip-Hop a trend!
author: Lauryn Hill

quote: Human speech is like a cracked kettle on which we tap crude rhythms for bears to dance to, while we long to make music that will melt the stars.
author: Gustave Flaubert

quote: Extraordinary how potent cheap music is.
author: Noel Coward

quote: Music is a lady that I still love because she gives me the air that I breathe. We need all sorts of nourishment. And music satisfies and nourishes the hunger within ourselves for connection and harmony.
author: Cat Stevens

quote: Leaders must encourage their organizations to dance to forms of music yet to be heard.
author: Warren G. Bennis

quote: When she had passed, it seemed like the ceasing of exquisite music.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: Music can name the unnameable and communicate the unknowable.
author: Leonard Bernstein

quote: I guess you could say I devoted myself so strongly to my music that for awhile I forgot about my family. But I only get one set of parents, and I think I forgot about that for a little while.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I think what made it difficult for people to get, and still makes it difficult for people to get, is the theatrical nature of the work and the fact that, my music doesn't exist without the performance-art element.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Film as dream, film as music. No art passes our conscience in the way film does, and goes directly to our feelings, deep down into the dark rooms of our souls.
author: Ingmar Bergman

quote: My dad, bless him, was a musician. And his dad had thought that his music was rubbish.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: All music is folk music. I ain't never heard a horse sing a song.
author: Louis Armstrong

quote: There is two kinds of music, the good, and the bad. I play the good kind.
author: Louis Armstrong

quote: People haven't always been there for me, but music always has.
author: Taylor Swift

quote: I think older people can appreciate my music because I really show my heart when I sing, and it's not corny. I think I can grow as an artist, and my fans will grow with me.
author: Justin Bieber

quote: At the age when Bengali youth almost inevitably writes poetry, I was listening to European classical music.
author: Satyajit Ray

quote: The dance can reveal everything mysterious that is hidden in music, and it has the additional merit of being human and palpable. Dancing is poetry with arms and legs.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: Music was important. Football was the easy part.
author: Zinedine Zidane

quote: I like pop music. I consider rock 'n' roll to be a branch of pop music.
author: Tom Stoppard

quote: When I listen to music these days, and I hear Pro Tools and drums that sound like a machine - it kinda sucks the life out of music.
author: Dave Grohl

quote: It was Elvis who really got me hooked on beat music. When I heard 'Heartbreak Hotel' I thought, this is it.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: Music itself is going to become like running water or electricity. So it's like, just take advantage of these last few years because none of this is ever going to happen again. You'd better be prepared for doing a lot of touring because that's really the only unique situation that's going to be left.
author: David Bowie

quote: If the king loves music, there is little wrong in the land.
author: Mencius

quote: There is pleasure in the pathless woods, there is rapture in the lonely shore, there is society where none intrudes, by the deep sea, and music in its roar I love not Man the less, but Nature more.
author: George Byron

quote: Music is your own experience, your own thoughts, your wisdom. If you don't live it, it won't come out of your horn. They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.
author: Charlie Parker

quote: I mean, just because you're a musician doesn't mean all your ideas are about music. So every once in a while I get an idea about plumbing, I get an idea about city government, and they come the way they come.
author: Jerry Garcia

quote: If I hadn't of had music in my life, it's quite possible I'd be dead and I'd much rather be alive.
author: James Hetfield

quote: There is geometry in the humming of the strings, there is music in the spacing of the spheres.
author: Pythagoras

quote: Have you listened to the radio lately? Have you heard the canned, frozen and processed product being dished up to the world as American popular music today?
author: Billy Joel

quote: Music is the refuge of souls ulcerated by happiness.
author: Emile M. Cioran

quote: I think the most important thing about music is the sense of escape.
author: Thom Yorke

quote: Where I come from it was really unheard of to be at a party and someone says, 'What kind of music do you make?', and you say, 'Pop music.' You may as well have 'I'm not cool' stamped on your forehead.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I dropped out of NYU, moved out of my parent's house, got my own place, and survived on my own. I made music and worked my way from the bottom up.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I decided to pursue music, so I dropped out of school and I told my parents I didn't want any money from them. I got three jobs and I just hit the ground running.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Actors are agents of change. A film, a piece of theater, a piece of music, or a book can make a difference. It can change the world.
author: Alan Rickman

quote: I wanted to prove the sustaining power of music.
author: David Bowie

quote: I don't profess to have music as my big wheel and there are a number of other things as important to me apart from music. Theatre and mime, for instance.
author: David Bowie

quote: The absolute transformation of everything that we ever thought about music will take place within 10 years, and nothing is going to be able to stop it. I see absolutely no point in pretending that it's not going to happen. I'm fully confident that copyright, for instance, will no longer exist in 10 years.
author: David Bowie

quote: I'm well past the age where I'm acceptable. You get to a certain age and you are forbidden access. You're not going to get the kind of coverage that you would like in music magazines, you're not going to get played on radio and you're not going to get played on television. I have to survive on word of mouth.
author: David Bowie

quote: Agressive music can only shock you once. Afterwards its impact declines. It's inevitable.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Music's always been really cathartic. It's the best drug for me to get away from the everyday pressures just for a second via a good song.
author: Ville Valo

quote: I would love to continue in music, with writing... but I am not the kind of person who will hang around if I start to become irrelevant. If that happens, I will bow down gracefully, raise my kids, and have a garden. And I am going to let my hair go gray when I am older. I don't need to be blonde when I'm 60!
author: Taylor Swift

quote: I think I first realized I wanted to be in country music and be an artist when I was 10. And I started dragging my parents to festivals, and fairs, and karaoke contests, and I did that for about a year before I came to Nashville for the first time. I was 11 and I had this demo CD of me singing Dixie Chicks and Leanne Rimes songs.
author: Taylor Swift

quote: The earth has grown old with its burden of care, but at Christmas it always is young, the heart of the jewel burns lustrous and fair, and its soul full of music breaks the air, when the song of angels is sung.
author: Phillips Brooks

quote: I'll give up this sort of touring madness certainly, but music-everything is based on music. No, I'll never stop my music.
author: George Harrison

quote: I saw music as a way to entertain people and take them away from their daily lives and put smiles on their faces, as opposed to what I see it being now, which is a way for me to actually communicate, and a way for me to tap into my subconscious.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: A painter paints his pictures on canvas. But musicians paint their pictures on silence. We provide the music, and you provide the silence.
author: Leopold Stokowski

quote: I love to play music. So why endanger that with something like drugs?
author: Dave Grohl

quote: What annoys the hell out of me is the arrogance of some people. They don't even listen to our music, they decided in advance that they don't like it.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: Music fathoms the sky.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: Music begins to atrophy when it departs too far from the dance... poetry begins to atrophy when it gets too far from music.
author: Ezra Pound

quote: Pop music will never be low brow.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Unless I am both capable of and willing to reopen the wound every time I write a song, if I choose to not look inside myself to write music, I'm really not worth being called an artist at all.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I write music every day.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I don't want to make niche-oriented music.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I was doing these performance art pop music pieces in the city. And they were a bit on the eccentric side I suppose. So people started to call me Gaga after the Queen song 'Radio Gaga.'
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I just want to keep writing music.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I've always been suspicious of TV, I've always found music and video to be an unhappy marriage.
author: Keith Richards

quote: You know, the BBC had not been particularly generous in its deliverance of blues and esoteric kinds of music.
author: Keith Richards

quote: I realized that it's all really one, that John Lennon was correct. We utilize the music to bring down the walls of Berlin, to bring up the force of compassion and forgiveness and kindness between Palestines, Hebrews. Bring down the walls here in San Diego, Tijuana, Cuba.
author: Carlos Santana

quote: When people in stadiums do the Wave, it's the group-mind collective organism spontaneously organizing itself to express an emotion, pass time, and reflect the joy of seeing the rhythms of many as one, a visual rhyming or music in which everyone senses where the motion is going.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Music is my shining light, my favorite thing in the world. T get me to stop doing it for one second would be difficult!
author: Taylor Swift

quote: For me, great music doesn't just have to fall into one category or one genre and I love appreciating all kinds of music.
author: Taylor Swift

quote: Music is the soundtrack to the crappy movie that is my life.
author: Chris Rock

quote: Certainly tolerance and acceptance were at the forefront of my music.
author: Bruce Springsteen

quote: Adult life is dealing with an enormous amount of questions that don't have answers. So I let the mystery settle into my music. I don't deny anything, I don't advocate anything, I just live with it.
author: Bruce Springsteen

quote: Well-written words are music.
author: William Shatner

quote: Inspiration for my music just comes from, you know, my life experiences.
author: Avril Lavigne

quote: I am severely distracted these days. It's hard to sit in front of the computer, uploading bad music for hours, when you have a wonderful boyfriend who treats you like a Goddess.
author: April Winchell

quote: I believe music should reflect yourself in some way and not just yourself at the given time. I feel that when you die or when you're going, someone's supposed to listen to that music and know everything about you. And I just try to get that across.
author: Lil Wayne

quote: I doubt I'll be singing forever, because at some point people aren't going to want to hear my music, and I hope that I'll still get the opportunity to write songs.
author: Adele

quote: I get mad. I get sad. I have all those emotions. But I just like to keep them to myself. I don't think my fans need to be bothered with if I'm mad or sad about something. I should just be concerned that they are keeping up with my music or I'm making them happy with my show.
author: Demi Lovato

quote: Anything I do has to be directly related to my music. If it isn't, I don't really see a point to it.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Over the last couple of years, I've really worked toward balancing my life out more, having a little bit more time with friends, family and my boyfriend. There was a period of time when they were way down the list. It was all about music and touring and if everything fell by the wayside, so be it.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: I started playing piano when I was 6. And I knew that wanted to be involved in that form of expression, whether it was through music, or acting, or dancing, or painting, or writing.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: I'm clearly most well known for my music. Eventually, ultimately, I'll be writing books. I'm still writing articles now. I just consider myself a writer.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: I've been really enjoying writing articles and writing music and music for movies.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: My message to anyone who's afraid that they can't write music when they're happy is 'Just trust the passion.' The passion can write a lot of things.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: What influenced me was Tori Amos, who was unapologetic about expressing anger through music, and Sinead O'Connor. Those two in particular were really moving for me, and very inspiring, before I wrote 'Jagged Little Pill.'
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: It's not just the 'Grammys' that I've pulled out of. I also pulled out of the English awards as well. The reason that I wanted to pull out was because I believe very much that the music industry as a whole is mainly concerned with material success.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Music will always be a part of my life. I love music and I don't care how many units I sell.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: I don't like painting flowers in my music. I like painting guts and pain.
author: Jonathan Davis

quote: Music is a great energizer. It's a language everybody knows.
author: Bill Hicks

quote: Music has always been my back door to life. It is important for people to find something that excites them. I like the concept that if you do what excites you, you will be rewarded generously, whatever form reward takes, which is not necessarily money.
author: Brandon Boyd

quote: I'm not terribly happy about rock and roll. Certain rock music is uninspiring, numbing it makes you feel like an idiot.
author: Manuel Puig

quote: Racism is taught in the home. We agree on that? Well, it's very hard to teach racism to a teenager who's listening to rap music and who idolizes, say, Snoop Dogg. It's hard to say, 'That guy is less than you.' The kid is like, 'I like that guy, he's cool. How is he less than me?
author: Jay-Z

quote: We're five people, five individuals who came together to create something, to make music and to complete each other musically, to form a perfect circle.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: I would say that although my music may be or may have been part of the cultural background fabric of the gay community, I consider myself an outsider who belongs everywhere and nowhere... Being a human being is what truly counts. That's where you'll find me.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: Music is the effort we make to explain to ourselves how our brains work. We listen to Bach transfixed because this is listening to a human mind.
author: Lewis Thomas

quote: All that stuff about heavy metal and hard rock, I don't subscribe to any of that. It's all just music. I mean, the heavy metal from the Seventies sounds nothing like the stuff from the Eighties, and that sounds nothing like the stuff from the Nineties. Who's to say what is and isn't a certain type of music?
author: Ozzy Osbourne

quote: It is jazz music that called me to be a musician and I have always sang the songs that moved me the most.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I don't think I'd ever make an album of just covers because I love writing my own music.
author: Taylor Swift

quote: The business aspect is one of the most important things about having a music career, because every choice you make in a management meeting affects your life a year-and-a-half from now.
author: Taylor Swift

quote: Country fans need to support country music by buying albums and concert tickets for traditional artists or the music will just fade away. And that would be really sad.
author: George Jones

quote: Learning music by reading about it is like making love by mail.
author: Luciano Pavarotti

quote: I sought my father in the world of the black musician, because it contained wisdom, experience, sadness and loneliness. I was not ever interested in the music of boys. From my youngest years, I was interested in the music of men.
author: Eric Clapton

quote: I have never denied my background or my culture. I have taught my child to embrace her Mexican heritage, to love my first language, Spanish, to learn about Mexican history, music, folk art, food, and even the Mexican candy I grew up with.
author: Salma Hayek

quote: The sound and music are 50% of the entertainment in a movie.
author: George Lucas

quote: Life is like music, it must be composed by ear, feeling and instinct, not by rule. Nevertheless one had better know the rules, for they sometimes guide in doubtful cases, though not often.
author: Paracelsus

quote: Placebo is music for outsiders, by outsiders and our gigs are like conventions of outcasts, which is cool.
author: Brian Molko

quote: I think music is the most phenomenal platform for intellectual thought.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: I believe that music is another form of news. Music is another form of journalism to me so I have to cover all the areas with my album.
author: Lil Wayne

quote: You used to have to sing and convey emotion, and now, well, technically you can do anything with technology. It sucks for music today, but that's why that old music feels so good to me.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: As a boy, I'd always had an interest in theater. But the idea at my school was that drama and music were to round out the man. It wasn't what one did for a living. I got over that.
author: Hugh Jackman

quote: Musicians are there in front of you, and the spectators sense their tension, which is not the case when you're listening to a record. Your attention is more relaxed. The emotional aspect is more important in live music.
author: Brian Eno

quote: You can't really imagine music without technology.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Good music is very close to primitive language.
author: Denis Diderot

quote: I don't have any real spirituality in my life - I'm kind of an atheist - but when music can take me to the highest heights, it's almost like a spiritual feeling. It fills that void for me.
author: Jack Black

quote: All I do is play music and golf - which one do you want me to give up?
author: Willie Nelson

quote: What is music. A passion for colonies not a love of country.
author: Gertrude Stein

quote: Those who seek to satisfy the mind of man by hampering it with ceremonies and music and affecting charity and devotion have lost their original nature.
author: Zhuangzi

quote: Music is an extraordinary vehicle for expressing emotion - very powerful emotions. That's what draws millions of people towards it. And, um, I found myself always going for these darker places and - people identify with that.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: I think one of my favorite things to do is just lock myself up in a small room and listen to music and watch films for a day. Also I just like seeing my friends. We have pizza parties which means I get four friends round, we eat a pizza and we're really lazy and we play PlayStation.
author: Daniel Radcliffe

quote: Music and silence combine strongly because music is done with silence, and silence is full of music.
author: Marcel Marceau

quote: The music business is motivated by money. Music is motivated by energy and feelings.
author: Erykah Badu

quote: Love cannot express the idea of music, while music may give an idea of love.
author: Hector Berlioz

quote: This music won't do. There's not enough sarcasm in it.
author: Samuel Goldwyn

quote: Please write music like Wagner, only louder.
author: Samuel Goldwyn

quote: There are a lot of bands who claim to be punk and they only play the music, they have no clue what it's all about. It's a lifestyle. It's not about popularity and all that crap.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: Music rhythms are mathematical patterns. When you hear a song and your body starts moving with it, your body is doing math. The kids in their parents' garage practicing to be a band may not realize it, but they're also practicing math.
author: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

quote: Music is like a huge release of tension.
author: James Taylor

quote: I had to learn my faith and look after my family, and I had to make priorities. But now I've done it all and there's a little space for me to fill in the universe of music again.
author: Cat Stevens

quote: Popular music formed the soundtrack of my life.
author: Martin Scorsese

quote: I am trying to walk a tightrope trying to keep the DJ community happy while trying to spread the message about dance music to more people. That is the mission that I am on.
author: David Guetta

quote: Yeah, I've been interested in music since I was a teenager, always writing songs.
author: Jeff Bridges

quote: My aim is just to make good music every single time.
author: Lil Wayne

quote: For me the visual is just as important as the music.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: Blues and soul and jazz music has so much pain, so much beauty of raw emotion and passion.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: There are only two things worth aiming for, good music and a clean conscience.
author: Paul Hindemith

quote: Of emotions, of love, of breakup, of love and hate and death and dying, mama, apple pie, and the whole thing. It covers a lot of territory, country music does.
author: Johnny Cash

quote: We're a bit flashy, but the music's not one big noise.
author: Freddie Mercury

quote: The music stuff is just a hobby.
author: Tom Felton

quote: I hate the rock music tradition. I can't bear it!
author: Brian Eno

quote: Avant-garde music is sort of research music. You're glad someone's done it but you don't necessarily want to listen to it.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I'd love it if American kids were listening to Muslim music.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Music is the emotional life of most people.
author: Leonard Cohen

quote: The spiral in a snail's shell is the same mathematically as the spiral in the Milky Way galaxy, and it's also the same mathematically as the spirals in our DNA. It's the same ratio that you'll find in very basic music that transcends cultures all over the world.
author: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

quote: I found music to be the therapy of choice.
author: David Byrne

quote: The trouble with music appreciation in general is that people are taught to have too much respect for music they should be taught to love it instead.
author: Igor Stravinsky

quote: City people live the city. We live in L.A., New York, we live in places where it's chaotic and you never know what's gonna happen. And that's the music - you never know what's gonna happen.
author: Alice Cooper

quote: In a weird kind of way, music has afforded me an idealism and perfectionism that I could never attain as me.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: That was a time when I did love music, I couldn't get enough of what was going on. Maybe it was Nirvana that brought me back. I guess it was a comfort because something that sounded so right - and non-commercial - had become so influential, so immediately.
author: Marc Jacobs

quote: You can't fake this music. You might be a great singer or a great musician but, in the need, that's got nothing to do with it. It's how you connect to the songs and to the history behind them.
author: Etta James

quote: Music is for every single person that walks the planet.
author: Robert Plant

quote: When I was a kid, I was following black soul music.
author: Robert Plant

quote: Entertainment isn't just based on the very structured syndrome of European popular music, and it's great that there are so many thousands of people who are of the same opinion.
author: Robert Plant

quote: Since I was a kid, I've had an absolute obsession with particular kinds of American music. Mississippi Delta blues of the Thirties, Chicago blues of the Fifties, West Coast music of the mid-Sixties - but I'd never really touched on dark Americana.
author: Robert Plant

quote: I'm just lucky because my kids are grown-up - I love them, very proud of them, and we are in close contact as big-time friends, but they don't need me that much now and I can actually enjoy this wonderful world of music.
author: Robert Plant

quote: I like to comprehend more or less everything around me - apart from the creation of my music. It's an obsessive character trait that's getting worse. I don't switch the light on and off 15 times before I leave the room yet, but something's going wrong.
author: Robert Plant

quote: I don't care what people say about my relationship I don't care what they say about my boobs. People are buying my songs I have a sold-out tour. I'm getting incredible feedback from my music.
author: Katy Perry

quote: The true beauty of music is that it connects people. It carries a message, and we, the musicians, are the messengers.
author: Roy Ayers

quote: My parents started with very little and were the only ones in their families to graduate from college. As parents, they focused on education, but did not stop at academics - they made sure that we knew music, saw art and theatre and traveled - even though it meant budgeting like crazy.
author: Jennifer Garner

quote: Music can be healing, and with my history and my knowledge of both sides of what looks like a gigantic divide in the world, I feel I can point a way forward to our common humanity again.
author: Cat Stevens

quote: I suppose that by being absent from the music business, it appeared that I just dropped out, but really I never did. I was continuously working and doing various things.
author: Cat Stevens

quote: Music is the only language in which you cannot say a mean or sarcastic thing.
author: John Erskine

quote: I mean, music totally comes from your soul.
author: Martin Scorsese

quote: The bottom line is, I tend to be going back to older and older music.
author: Martin Scorsese

quote: Music I heard with you was more than music, and bread I broke with you was more than bread. Now that I am without you, all is desolate all that was once so beautiful is dead.
author: Conrad Aiken

quote: Pop is actually my least favorite kind of music, because it lacks real depth.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: I turned to music originally because of my past and needing a release or an outlet to get out anger or frustration or hurt.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: Music can be made anywhere, is invisible and does not smell.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: I was never too keen on the British music press. They've called us a supermarket hype, and they used to suggest that we didn't write our own songs.
author: Freddie Mercury

quote: First of all, the music that people call Latin or Spanish is really African. So Black people need to get the credit for that.
author: Carlos Santana

quote: My job in this life is to give people spiritual ecstasy through music. In my concerts people cry, laugh, dance. If they climaxed spiritually, I did my job. I did it decently and honestly.
author: Carlos Santana

quote: That's why people listen to music or look at paintings. To get in touch with that wholeness.
author: Corita Kent

quote: But maybe music was not intended to satisfy the curious definiteness of man. Maybe it is better to hope that music may always be transcendental language in the most extravagant sense.
author: Charles Ives

quote: At the beginning of the 20th century, the ambition of the great painters was to make paintings that were like music, which was then considered as the noblest art.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I wanted to get rid of the element that had been considered essential in pop music: the voice.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Music in itself carries a whole set of messages which are very, very rich and complex, and the words either serve to exclude certain ones or point up certain others.
author: Brian Eno

quote: The lyrics are constructed as empirically as the music. I don't set out to say anything very important.
author: Brian Eno

quote: We are increasingly likely to find ourselves in places with background music. No composers have thought to write for these modern spaces, which represent 30% of our musical experience.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I make a lot of pieces of music that I never release as CDs.
author: Brian Eno

quote: It's nice, I think, when people use your music for things you didn't think of.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I don't like headphones very much, and I rarely listen to music on headphones.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I think we're about ready for a new feeling to enter music. I think that will come from the Arabic world.
author: Brian Eno

quote: People do dismiss ambient music, don't they? They call it 'easy listening,' as if to suggest that it should be hard to listen to.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I hate talking about music, to tell you the truth.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Once music ceases to be ephemeral - always disappearing - and becomes instead material... it leaves the condition of traditional music and enters the condition of painting. It becomes a painting, existing as material in space, not immaterial in time.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Editing is now the easiest thing on earth to do, and all the things that evolved out of word processing - 'Oh, let's put that sentence there, let's get rid of this' - have become commonplace in films and music too.
author: Brian Eno

quote: For instance, I'm always fascinated to see whether, given the kind of fairly known and established form called popular music, whether there is some magic combination that nobody has hit upon before.
author: Brian Eno

quote: There are certain sounds that I've found work well in nearly any context. Their function is not so much musical as spatial: they define the edges of the territory of the music.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Once I started working with generative music in the 1970s, I was flirting with ideas of making a kind of endless music - not like a record that you'd put on, which would play for a while and finish.
author: Brian Eno

quote: One often makes music to supplement one's world.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I've got a feeling that music might not be the most interesting place to be in the world of things.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Most game music is based on loops effectively.
author: Brian Eno

quote: In England and Europe, we have this huge music called ambient - ambient techno, ambient house, ambient hip-hop, ambient this, ambient that.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Lyrics are always misleading because they make people think that that's what the music is about.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I got interested in the idea of music that could make itself, in a sense, in the mid 1960s really, when I first heard composers like Terry Riley, and when I first started playing with tape recorders.
author: Brian Eno

quote: The whole history of pop music had rested on the first person singular, with occasional intrusions of the second person singular.
author: Brian Eno

quote: The prospect of music being detachable from time and place meant that one could start to think of music as a part of one's furniture.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Perhaps when music has been shouting for so long, a quieter voice seems attractive.
author: Brian Eno

quote: Lyrics are the only thing to do with music that haven't been made easier technically.
author: Brian Eno

quote: When superstition is allowed to perform the task of old age in dulling the human temperament, we can say goodbye to all excellence in poetry, in painting, and in music.
author: Denis Diderot

quote: I've had to keep exploring different ways of presenting the music so I don't repeat myself.
author: Tori Amos

quote: People listen to music the way they want to listen to music.
author: Tori Amos

quote: I don't see music as working.
author: Tori Amos

quote: My father was a minister and so rock music was banned in our house.
author: Tori Amos

quote: This was a time frame when dance music and clubs were having a real impact on culture, and it had an impact on me.
author: Tori Amos

quote: Music is always a reflection of what's going on in the hearts and minds of the culture.
author: Tori Amos

quote: Some of the greatest blues music is some of the darkest music you've ever heard.
author: Bruce Springsteen

quote: I was irrevocably betrothed to laughter, the sound of which has always seemed to me the most civilised music in the world.
author: Peter Ustinov

quote: We are the music makers. We are the dreamers of the dream.
author: Arthur O'Shaughnessy

quote: Rap music's been around for too long now to be inspirational. The words are, but the music isn't.
author: Alexander McQueen

quote: What we don't need in country music is divisiveness, public criticism of each other, and some arbitrary judgement of what belongs and what doesn't.
author: Charley Pride

quote: From the beginning, I knew intuitively that if nothing else, music was safe, and that nobody could tell me anything about it. Music didn't need a middleman, whereas all the other things in school needed some kind of explanation.
author: Eric Clapton

quote: With music, you often don't have to translate it. It just affects you, and you don't know why.
author: David Byrne

quote: I try to devote my afternoons to making music in my home studio, but it's a lot more fun hanging out with musicians and friends, and trying subtly to influence a band than making your own stuff.
author: David Byrne

quote: I happened to come along in the music business when there was no trend.
author: Elvis Presley

quote: I dabbled in things like Howlin' Wolf, Cream and Led Zeppelin, but when I heard Son House and Robert Johnson, it blew my mind. It was something I'd been missing my whole life. That music made me discard everything else and just get down to the soul and honesty of the blues.
author: Jack White

quote: There are so many opportunities in life, that the loss of two or three capabilities is not necessarily debilitating. A handicap can give you the opportunity to focus more on art, writing, or music.
author: Jim Davis

quote: I love music.
author: Shania Twain

quote: I have such happy memories of performing in a choir and I don't think I'd have got where I am today without all that experience. So my advice to young singers is to either join your school or church's choir or find one in your local area. Choral music at any level teaches you so much about musicianship and blending your voice.
author: Katherine Jenkins

quote: The business side of film has goofed up so many things, but even that's changing. It happened to the music industry and now it's happening to the film studios. It's crazy what's going on. But artists should have control of their work especially if, as I always say, you never turn down a good idea and never take a bad idea.
author: David Lynch

quote: I travel the garden of music, thru inspiration. It's a large, very large garden, seen?
author: Peter Tosh

quote: I've seen country music go uptown, like we say, and I'm proud I was there when it happened.
author: Loretta Lynn

quote: I love country music, blues, and punk, and one day I might make those kinds of records.
author: Kesha

quote: I think there's nothing better than seeing a three-chord straight up rock 'n' roll band in your face with sweaty music and three minute good songs.
author: Joan Jett

quote: It had never occurred to me before that music and thinking are so much alike. In fact you could say music is another way of thinking, or maybe thinking is another kind of music.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quote: The desire to hit a big home run is dominating the music business.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: When you actually like each other, it translates to the music.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: You have to be willing to deal with the ups and downs of the music, the ups and downs of the audience.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: To be able to put your arms around 24 years of music, it's really fun.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: Music is your guide.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: I'm prepared to spend the rest of my life playing clubs, if that means I'm playing music that I believe in.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: People think I take some sort of masochistic pleasure out of putting out music that's gonna be unpopular.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: I was fantasising about my own death, I started thinking what my funeral would be like and what music would be played, I was at that level of insanity.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: Most of my arguments with musicians through the years have had more to do with their attitude about music, or their attitude about their own lives, or their personal responsibility. Music has never really been the big centerpiece of the fight.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: The ideology of the Smashing Pumpkins was ultimately more valuable than the music of the Smashing Pumpkins. That's what critics can't put their finger on.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: To re-embrace what I once loved about music has been a warming process for me, because it's a good, earned feeling now.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: Cinematography is infinite in its possibilities... much more so than music or language.
author: Conrad Hall

quote: It was all about music, about getting your friends to come and see you play. I don't see that same intimacy happening very much today.
author: Layne Staley

quote: Mathematics is, as it were, a sensuous logic, and relates to philosophy as do the arts, music, and plastic art to poetry.
author: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel

quote: I believe it is in my nature to dance by virtue of the beat of my heart, the pulse of my blood and the music in my mind.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: If you like my music, great, and if you don't, whatever. I'm going to keep making it either way.
author: Katy Perry

quote: Oh, I will always be honest with my music. The records are black boxes for me. Like if you want to know who I am, my views, my perspective, things I love, things I hate, my convictions, my anthems. I've never let people's opinions affect the way I write.
author: Katy Perry

quote: Music - that's been my education. There's not a day that goes by that I take it for granted.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: I love jazz music and sad music. I'm a sentimental guy. I'm a romantic guy.
author: Fred Durst

quote: Does art have a future? Performance genres like opera, theater, music and dance are thriving all over the world, but the visual arts have been in slow decline for nearly 40 years. No major figure of profound influence has emerged in painting or sculpture since the waning of Pop Art and the birth of Minimalism in the early 1970s.
author: Camille Paglia

quote: The only love affair I have ever had was with music.
author: Maurice Ravel

quote: There are certain things in which mediocrity is not to be endured, such as poetry, music, painting, public speaking.
author: Jean de la Bruyere

quote: If anyone asks you what kind of music you play, tell him 'pop.' Don't tell him 'rock'n'roll' or they won't even let you in the hotel.
author: Buddy Holly

quote: I'd call what I do pop music, but it's folky and electronic and it doesn't really sound like much else.
author: Ellie Goulding

quote: We're not uncomfortable with it, and we've already been through enough of the music business where I'm not really worried that commercial success is going to in some way - we're already past saving, you know what I mean? It's too late for us.
author: Jerry Garcia

quote: A verbal art like poetry is reflective it stops to think. Music is immediate, it goes on to become.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: Mumford &amp Sons' music appeals to a lot of America. I'm really proud of them.
author: Ellie Goulding

quote: To know how to suggest is the great art of teaching. To attain it we must be able to guess what will interest we must learn to read the childish soul as we might a piece of music. Then, by simply changing the key, we keep up the attraction and vary the song.
author: Henri Frederic Amiel

quote: Men are wary of me because they know, by listening to my music, that a relationship with me will be quite deep.
author: Ellie Goulding

quote: I've been all over the world. I love New York, I love Paris, San Francisco, so many places. But there's no place like New Orleans. It's got the best food. It's got the best music. It's got the best people. It's got the most fun stuff to do.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I'm quite private. And I never wanted to be the biggest star in the world, really. So in that sense I've got a good balance of doing great shows, of making an appearance every now and then and writing music, and I don't really have to do much else.
author: Ellie Goulding

quote: Music of all arts should be expansive and inclusive.
author: Jesse Jackson

quote: People always try to find my agenda, but I don't really have one. It's safe to say that I make pop, but I think that I'm doing important music, too. I've just always done what I wanted to do.

quote: Since I met Starsmith, my producer, I really feel like I'm making music because we write it together and produce it together. I've got a proper involvement in the end product as opposed to just writing a song and finding someone else to produce it.

quote: Because of the Thames I have always loved inland waterways - water in general, water sounds - there's music in water. Brooks babbling, fountains splashing. Weirs, waterfalls tumbling, gushing.

quote: I never gave up on country music because I knew what I was doing was not that bad.

quote: I'd like a male to listen to my music and find it kind of fascinating, what a girl goes through when they get heartbroken or get sad or get hurt by something.

quote: A lot of country music is sad.

quote: There's a great enthusiasm for good country music all over the world.
author: Willie Nelson

quote: I think Ray Charles did as much as anybody when he did his country music album. Ray Charles broke down borders and showed the similarities between country music and R&ampB.

quote: I've always said that Adele has turned so many people on to British singers - whether female singers or just like music from this country in general.

quote: I'm obsessed with the countryside: woods, forests, fields, lakes, mountains. I'm really into folk music and folklore. But more so I'm into electronic music. quote: I need music. It's like my heartbeat, so to speak. It keeps me going no matter what's going on - bad games, press, whatever!

quote: I don't really have a style icon but I really admire the way people dress like Gaga, Rihanna and Gwen Stefani. author: Ellie Goulding

quote: It is so characteristic, that just when the mechanics of reproduction are so vastly improved, there are fewer and fewer people who know how the music should be played.

quote: Pop changes week to week, month to month. But great music is like literature.
author: Ravi Shankar

quote: I started getting these attacks in 2009, just as my music career was taking off. I'd be doing photo-shoots and started to feel like I was having heart attacks. quote: I was always struck by how Picasso had no interest in music.

quote: I start really missing London when I go away. I have a little flat, but very central. I live above a pub and you'd think it'd be a nightmare, but I like hearing the music and it's quite comforting.

quote: I didn't want to go out and change anything. I just wanted to make the music that was part of my background, which was rock and blues and hip-hop.

quote: You create a community with music, not just at concerts but by talking about it with your friends.

quote: I've noticed a lot of younger artists have less fear of doing different sorts of things, whether it's various types of music, or gallery artists moving between video and sculpture and drawing.
author: David Byrne

quote: The making of music is profoundly affected by the market.
author: David Byrne

quote: We don't make music - it makes us.
author: David Byrne

quote: People are already finding ways to make their music and play it in front of people and have a life in music, I guess, and I think that's pretty much all you can ask.
author: David Byrne

quote: Even from a listening end now, I'm still completely a fan of music.

quote: I'm not suggesting people abandon musical instruments and start playing their cars and apartments, but I do think the reign of music as a commodity made only by professionals might be winding down.

quote: We tend to mistake music for the physical object.

quote: I've rarely seen video screens used well in a music concert.

quote: There's more good music being made now than ever before.
author: David Byrne

quote: Why not invest in the future of music, instead of building fortresses to preserve its past?

quote: The imminent demise of the large record companies as gatekeepers of the world's popular music is a good thing, for the most part.

quote: I think I'm a music fan before anything else.

author: John Entwistle

quote: If anything, a lot of electronic music is music that no one listens to at home, hardly. It's really only to be heard when everyone's out enjoying it.
author: David Byrne

quote: Ninety percent of all music is always crap, and when too many people decide they're going to have guitar bands, then ninety percent of them are going to be crap. It's just a given law.
author: David Byrne

quote: It seems almost backwards to me that my music seems the more emotional outlet, and the art stuff seems more about ideas.
author: David Byrne

quote: There's something about music that encourages people to want to know more about the person that made it, and where it was recorded, what year it was done, what they were listening to, and all this kind of stuff. There's something that invites all this obsessive behavior.

quote: Everything we release with Tool is inspired by our music.

quote: Music is a great natural high and a great natural escape.

quote: My music must reflect whatever's going on in my mind, and my life needs to evolve for me to discover who it is I'm becoming.

quote: I think people need to have fun with whatever they're doing - makeup, their clothes, music, live shows - anything you don't need to take too seriously, don't take too seriously.

author: Kesha

author: Joan Jett

quote: I plan to stay in music. I plan to keep making records.
author: Joan Jett

quote: I sure saw a lot of kids that I'm sure didn't know a lot about us, or we were definitely new to them. The kids who came up to me afterward, we'd talk about music, sign a lot of autographs. So I'm sure we made a lot of new fans.

quote: I think what I'm going to do is get more balance in my life to still be able to go out and play the hard rock 'n' roll and do what I like to do in music.

author: Joan Jett

quote: I've done some acting and a lot of different things, but mostly it's the music.
author: Joan Jett

quote: Before I settled on music, I wanted to be an archaeologist, an astronaut, all sorts of really diverse things.
author: Joan Jett

author: Mary-Kate Olsen

quote: Pop music is not a threatening style of music.
author: Joan Jett

quote: I know music is subjective.
author: Joan Jett

quote: Well, I'll tell you, I don't know how aware teenagers are of me. I think it really depends on the teenager and how well-versed in music they are and what kind of music they like.
author: Joan Jett

quote: The music industry can make you feel like a prostitute.

quote: We're not trying to change the world just music.
author: Jonathan Davis

quote: I've been a fan of electronic music since the beginning.
author: Jonathan Davis

quote: It's really cool to see glowsticks at the show, to see dance music culture infiltrating and becoming one with the metal community.
author: Jonathan Davis

quote: It seems like a lot of music today is so churned out and simple.
author: Jonathan Davis

quote: Singing is just a feeling set to music.
author: Carrie Underwood

quote: The calm mind allows one to connect with the inner self, the Soul, the very source of our being. That's where the music lives. That's where my music comes from.

quote: At home I'm just a guy who has interests that extend far beyond music.
author: Layne Staley

quote: I wanted to take up music, so my father bought me a blunt instrument. He told me to knock myself out.
author: Jay London

quote: Music is about communication... it isn't just something that maybe physically sounds good or orally sounds interesting it's something far, far deeper than that.
author: Evelyn Glennie

quote: People think our music's very aggressive or angry or whatever, and it's just the opposite, really... I like laughing. And I like being really calm before a show, and smiley.

quote: Great classic music that I've been turned on to has not only inspired and influenced me, but it has had an effect on my songwriting.
author: Scott Weiland

quote: The great moments of rock 'n' roll were never off in some corner of the music world, in a self-constructed ghetto.
author: Bono

quote: Rock music is niche.
author: Bono

quote: If you pour some music on whatever's wrong, it'll sure help out.
author: Levon Helm

quote: Music was your real passion, this thing you held dear even above family. It was this relationship that never betrayed you. author: Eddie Vedder

quote: Pop music is aspirin and the blues are vitamins.
author: Peter Tork

quote: Music, at its essence, is what gives us memories. And the longer a song has existed in our lives, the more memories we have of it.

quote: Those who decide to use leisure as a means of mental development, who love good music, good books, good pictures, good plays, good company, good conversation - what are they? They are the happiest people in the world.

quote: A lot of music you might listen to is pretty vapid, it doesn't always deal with our deeper issues. These are the things I'm interested in now, particularly at my age.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: I love to make music and stay grounded.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: I only want to make music because I have a passion for it.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: I always think I'm the Tom Cruise of music - a lot of success and fans, but no critics, darling.
author: Jon Bon Jovi

quote: Music is a part of my life all the time - on the plane, before matches, driving out to the court.
author: Maria Sharapova

quote: The basis of our partnership strategy and our partnership approach: We build the social technology. They provide the music.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

quote: The music of Hendrix wakes people up to their possibilities. It's more than just dreaming about being a guitar hero.
author: Carlos Santana

quote: I don't like to be labeled, to be anything. I've made the mistake before myself of labeling my music, but it's counter-productive.
author: Neil Young

quote: I have so many opinions about everything it just comes out during my music. It's a battle for me. I try not to be preachy. That's a real danger.
author: Neil Young

quote: My music isn't anything but me. It has jazz in it, and rock'n'roll, and it has an urgency to it.
author: Neil Young

quote: The '60s was one of the first times the power of music was used by a generation to bind them together.
author: Neil Young

quote: The thing about my music is, there really is no point.
author: Neil Young

quote: Commitments are one of the worst things to have in the music business. They're very annoying.
author: Neil Young

quote: Music is part of us, and either ennobles or degrades our behavior.
author: Boethius

quote: Live music is better.
author: Neil Young

author: Neil Young

quote: It is jazz music that called me to be a musician and I have always sang the songs that moved me the most. Singers, like Frank Sinatra and myself, we interpret the songs that we like. author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I used to go to Bourbon Street when I was a kid and there would be club after club after club of people who were around when the music started. I mean these are legendary, maybe not so well known, but legendary musicians.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I've spent hours and hours doing research into Appalachian folk music. My grandfather was a fiddler. There is something very immediate, very simple and emotional, about that music.
author: Renee Fleming

quote: I don't play pyrotechnic scales. I play about frustration, patience, anger. Music is an extension of my soul.
author: Dick Dale

quote: Music my rampart, and my only one.
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

quote: I write the vocals last, because I wanted to invent the music first and push the music to the level that I had to compete against it.

quote: Alas! all music jars when the soul's out of tune.
author: Miguel de Cervantes

quote: They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.

quote: Soul music is timeless.
author: Alicia Keys

quote: When I was a young musician, the only option available to pursue secondary education in music was to attend a classical conservatory.
author: Billy Joel

quote: When I look at great works of art or listen to inspired music, I sense intimate portraits of the specific times in which they were created.
author: Billy Joel

quote: We are living in a time when American popular music is finally being recognized as one of our most successful exports. The demand is huge.
author: Billy Joel

quote: Most people are satisfied with the junk food being sold as music.
author: Billy Joel

quote: I'm probably writing music now for the same reason as I started writing songs when I was 14 - to meet women.
author: Billy Joel

quote: I can't think of one person I've ever met who didn't like some type of music.
author: Billy Joel

quote: Don't make music for some vast, unseen audience or market or ratings share or even for something as tangible as money. Though it's crucial to make a living, that shouldn't be your inspiration. Do it for yourself.
author: Billy Joel

quote: There's a constantly applicable nature to soul music, whereas sometimes pop music can be a periodical.

quote: I don't need my phone to play me music. I need it to be a phone and an e-mail thing.

quote: I've been composing music all my life and if I'd been clever enough at school I would like to have gone to music college.
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: I think everything Joni Mitchell did for music was big.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: Adam does most of the work when it comes to videos and he basically does the same as I do with the lyrics. The videos are his visual interpretations of our music.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: Reading is more of a left-brain process, and listening to music is a right-brain function.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: People always accuse me of being motivational in a way, like it was a bad thing, but that's just how I was raised. My mom raised me in a positive environment, with lots of love in my heart, and that reflects in my music.

quote: I feel this music has nurtured me as I've been immersing myself in it. I've felt supported by it.
author: Sting

quote: I hate most of what constitutes rock music, which is basically middle-aged crap.
author: Sting

quote: Yoga is almost like music in a way there's no end to it.
author: Sting

quote: I like when guests come over early and we chop veggies and talk and play music.
author: John Stamos

quote: I can play punk rock, and I love playing punk rock, but I was into every other style of music before I played punk rock.
author: Travis Barker

quote: Beyond a certain point, the music isn't mine anymore. It's yours.

quote: Music was always the distraction, so it was the obvious choice to pursue. My dad always said to find a job I love to do, that way it wouldn't feel like a job. So I did that.

quote: When people hear good music, it makes them homesick for something they never had, and never will have.
author: E. W. Howe

quote: Good music is good music, and everything else can go to hell.
author: Dave Matthews

quote: Country music is important to me, and I love it, but it's not my whole life.
author: George Strait

quote: The problem for me, still today, is that I write purely with one dramatic structure and that is the rite of passage. I'm not really skilled in any other. Rock and roll itself can be described as music to accompany the rite of passage.

quote: What I'm trying to do is find either existing properties or come up with properties or angles or stories which will create music drama. It's my obsession and most of all I would like to remain working in theatre. I think it's very much alive.
author: Pete Townshend

quote: Music exalts each joy, allays each grief, expels diseases, softens every pain, subdues the rage of poison, and the plague.
author: John Armstrong

quote: I felt that the elegance of pop music was that it was reflective: we were holding up a mirror to our audience and reflecting them philosophically and spiritually, rather than just reflecting society or something called 'rock and roll.'
author: Pete Townshend

quote: I just go with the flow, so any style can be in my music - that makes it exciting.
author: Yoko Ono

quote: Starting out really punk came from not knowing any better and listening to music like that, not knowing how to play music - well, still not knowing how to play music.
author: Beth Ditto

quote: The English may not like music, but they absolutely love the noise it makes.
author: Thomas Beecham

quote: I love sad songs. They say so much. I love country music but even the happy songs sound really sad.
author: Beth Ditto

quote: Music and the music business are two different things.
author: Erykah Badu

quote: I'm constantly thinking about what I'll do next. I never count on music being a career of longevity. I mean, longevity is key, and I hope that it lasts, but you just don't know, because it's not in your hands, you don't make the decision.
author: Beth Ditto

quote: The beautiful thing about hip-hop is it's like an audio collage. You can take any form of music and do it in a hip-hop way and it'll be a hip-hop song. That's the only music you can do that with.
author: Talib Kweli

quote: It's really hard for me to sometimes put myself out there, like 'Hey, how do you feel about making music together?' because maybe I'm afraid of rejection or I don't want to put anybody out. It's the Southerner in me, like, 'I don't mean to bother you but do you mind making a song?'
author: Beth Ditto

quote: I am quite certain in my heart of hearts that modern music and modern art is not a conspiracy, but is a form of truth and integrity for those who practise it honestly, decently and with all their being.
author: Michael Tippett

quote: I've never had a very quiet voice. I tried in choir to make it smaller, and it just didn't work out. And I listened to a lot of soul music when I was growing up on my own accord. But I was mostly into Mama Cass and Gladys Knight, and they all had big voices too just different than mine.
author: Beth Ditto

quote: My music is fun, kind of cheeky.
author: Kesha

quote: Olympia was a town crawling with music. I was new to the whole punk scene. The culture shock continued Olympia had bagels! We didn't have bagels in Arkansas. You could order vegetarian food all over town! It was so crazy to me - a place with so many vegetarians, the restaurants made special dishes for them?
author: Beth Ditto

quote: I do love country music.
author: Kesha

quote: I know that I can sing. That's the reason I started playing music when I was twelve years old.
author: Kesha

quote: Music for me is an emotional thing and it really does make me happy. It's not a tool for me to get fame or see my face in the papers or anything like that. It's about the fact that I really do enjoy it.
author: Ville Valo

quote: Bands are about these little relationships that make everything tick, and when you create new music you're testing those relationships.
author: Jonathan Cain

quote: Dreams do come true, even for someone who couldn't speak English and never had a music lesson or much of an education.
author: Lawrence Welk

quote: It's funny how the music industry is enraged about the Internet and the way things are copied without being paid for. But you know why people steal the music? Because they can't afford the music.
author: Tom Petty

quote: A man can stand a lot as long as he can stand himself. He can live without hope, without friends, without books, even without music, as long as he can listen to his own thoughts.
author: Axel Munthe

quote: I don't need anybody to market or promote me. If people don't want to hear this music, then it's not for them. You cannot please everybody.
author: Lauryn Hill

quote: For some young people, their first experience ever hearing punk rock music was playing the Green Bay Packers on 'Madden'.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: When I'm alone, I work sometimes with music, sometimes without and sometimes just listening to NPR.
author: Mikhail Baryshnikov

quote: A country is made not by policy alone, but by its music, its entertainment shows, all of it.
author: Glenn Beck

quote: Half the time I feel like I'm appealing to the downer freaks out there. We start to play one downer record after another until I begin to get down myself. Give me something from 1960 or something let me get up again. The music of today is for downer freaks, and I'm an upper.
author: Wolfman Jack

quote: I think the pop chart today is entirely market-driven. And it has nothing to do with public taste. And it has nothing to do with moving music forward. It's simply a market chart.
author: Steven Patrick Morrissey

quote: That's why this generation is the least racist generation ever. You see it all the time. Go to any club. People are intermingling, hanging out, having fun, enjoying the same music. Hip-hop is not just in the Bronx anymore. It's worldwide. Everywhere you go, people are listening to hip-hop and partying together. Hip-hop has done that.
author: Jay-Z

quote: Bluegrass has brought more people together and made more friends than any music in the world. You meet people at festivals and renew acquaintances year after year.
author: Bill Monroe

quote: My life so common it disappears and sometimes even music cannot substitute for tears.
author: Paul Simon

quote: Boy bands should be exploded from a great height. They're just pretty people singing music written by others.
author: Eddie Izzard

quote: To me, John Lennon and Elvis Presley were punks, because they made music that evoked those emotions in people.
author: Joey Ramone

quote: If I had to play only for people who liked the music because they heard it on the radio, it wouldn't make me happy. That's why I'm working so hard to have, yes, a profile as an artist, but also a profile as a DJ.
author: David Guetta

quote: Most recently we've been working in concert situations rather than clubs. because there aren't too many rooms there like Ronnie Scott's, that are pure music rooms, where people come specifically to listen to music.
author: Chuck Mangione

quote: But for the children of the poorest people we're stripping the curriculum, removing the arts and music, and drilling the children into useful labor. We're not valuing a child for the time in which she actually is a child.
author: Jonathan Kozol

quote: I don't listen to a lot of new stuff. I just like the old stuff. It's all quite dramatic and atmospheric. You'd have an entire story in song. I never listen to, like, white music - I couldn't sing you a Zeppelin or Floyd song.
author: Amy Winehouse

quote: I listen to music that is of our time and I just get angry.
author: Amy Winehouse

quote: Hunting, fishing, drawing, and music occupied my every moment. Cares I knew not, and cared naught about them.
author: John James Audubon

quote: I don't read music. I don't write it. So I wander around on the guitar until something starts to present itself.
author: James Taylor

quote: Men make angry music and it's called rock-and-roll women include anger in their vocabulary and suddenly they're angry and militant.
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: I basically get stereotyped a lot in terms of being a girl and writing 'chick' music for teenage girls or something. I think, if anything, the press kind of, because of my gender and my age, tends to kind of relegate my work to this sort of special-interest group. It's part of the cultural dynamic, I guess.
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: I seriously hate pop music and all things super-commercial.
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: I see a lot of connections between folk and punk music just because they're both subcorporate music - I mean, traditionally.
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: I've been trying to learn how to not be so conflicted about things like my own anger. I've always had a place in my music for my anger as a way of compensating for not having a mechanism to express it in my everyday life. So I've been trying to be more true to myself, and that helps me to chill out a little bit. But politically, uh-uh. No.
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: Pop stardom is not very compelling. I'm much more interested in a relationship between performer and audience that is of equals. I came up through folk music, and there's no pomp and circumstance to the performance. There's no, like, 'I'll be the rock star, you be the adulating fan.'
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: Ah, reality TV: where opportunists delight in exposing opportunism! It's kind of like the indie music scene.
author: Diablo Cody

quote: The principle of the endless melody is the perpetual becoming of a music that never had any reason for starting, any more than it has any reason for ending.
author: Igor Stravinsky

quote: Social topics may hit too close to home for people, but then again, if you pull a heartstring, then that's what country music is. It's not just songs about getting drunk and leaving your girl.
author: Kenny Chesney

quote: For me music is a vehicle to bring our pain to the surface, getting it back to that humble and tender spot where, with luck, it can lose its anger and become compassion again.
author: Paula Cole

quote: I love music passionately. And because I love it I try to free it from barren traditions that stifle it.
author: Claude Debussy

quote: And why is our music called world music? I think people are being polite. What they want to say is that it's third world music. Like they use to call us under developed countries, now it has changed to developing countries, it's much more polite.
author: Miriam Makeba

quote: I became a set designer for opera. I'm a great opera buff, I love classical music, and I needed a time-out.
author: Maurice Sendak

quote: It's a really unfair world because life is, where I am all day long we listen to American music. So I don't see why the radios in the U.S. cannot even put aside one hour a day just to play music that is not American.
author: Miriam Makeba

quote: There are certain pieces of music that are always attached to certain books.
author: Maurice Sendak

quote: I like so many different kinds of music just because all I did was listen to the radio as a kid.
author: Philip Seymour Hoffman

quote: I didn't know much about him, and I wasn't a big country music fan. I listened to the Beatles and David Bowie, so I didn't know a lot about him.
author: Joaquin Phoenix

quote: But however measurable, there is much more life in music than mathematics or logic ever dreamed of.
author: Gabriel Marcel

quote: It means so much being a part of country music and the Opry.
author: Martina McBride

quote: If architecture is frozen music then music must be liquid architecture.
author: Quincy Jones

quote: My friends are mostly familiar with music that plays on the mainstream radio.
author: Jessica Sanchez

quote: Jazz vision is the fusion of music and art a real paradox of same-yet different. Here we play in exchanges, like the hardness of the key of c# major and from the softness of Db major - capturing, reflecting and improvising.
author: Barbara Januszkiewicz

quote: I think it's a mistake where rap music is these days. It doesn't seem to be able to look out of the ghetto and that's ultimately unfortunate, because it defines our limitations.
author: Saul Williams

quote: Music is emotional, and you may catch a musician in a very unemotional mood or you may not be in the same frame of mind as the musician. So a critic will often say a musician is slipping.
author: Nat King Cole

quote: Great music is in a sense serene it is certain of the values it asserts.
author: Rebecca West

quote: If music leaves any impression at all, it does so without regard to stylistic issues.
author: Aulis Sallinen

quote: Country music has always sort of been country music.
author: Miranda Lambert

quote: Color is a plastic means of creating intervals... color harmonics produced by special relationships, or tensions. We differentiate now between formal tensions and color tensions, just as we differentiate in music between counterpoint and harmony.
author: Hans Hofmann

quote: From childhood I was passionately fond of music and wanted to be a musician. I have no recollection of any real desire ever to be anything else.
author: John Philip Sousa

quote: I realised a long time ago that instrumental music speaks a lot more clearly than English, Spanish, Yiddish, Swahili, any other language. Pure melody goes outside time.
author: Carlos Santana

quote: A lot of the music that you listen to now is because of the things that the Meters did, the Neville Brothers did, and they're there, the guys who invented those beats that the guys sample today. Such an enormous opportunity.
